verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents scoped API keys that grant only assigned Read or Write permissions on specific APIs instead of full account access. Its agent tooling also uses OAuth: the AgentOS MCP has no money-out actions by default, and CLI authorization is role-gated, which together support least-privilege credentials for agents. Missing for 10: detail on how agent-specific credentials are issued, scoped and revoked (e.g., whether OAuth grants for AgentOS can be narrowed per resource), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
